facts.why: The film only calls it the farmers market, and the transcript never uses the name Bountiful Harvest.
No source gives the market a name. The narrator calls the job the greatest farmers market heist in history.

facts.text: Barnabas swears this is the last job.
facts.why: Barnabas shares a big plan to rob the farmers market for dried fruit, but nobody calls it the last job.
facts.fix: Barnabas has a big plan for the dried fruit.

vibe.verdict: A friendly market truck, but it misses the dried fruit heist and most of the sequel's gags.
missing: The dried fruit heist at the farmers market (the market)
Sammy Whiskers and the gang with the pincushion map (Barnabas's hideout)
Mr Tod on a plant-based diet asking about jogging (the city)
Thomas's nut-eater list: almond milk, cashew cheese, walnut butter (pet store)
Peter hearing the book makes him the bad bunny (publisher meeting)
Rabbits caught by animal catchers and the pet pound (town)
ideas: Swap 'Honey oat and almond crunch mix' for a 'Dried fruit heist mix: lasts forever'.
Swap 'Gloucester chicken, leek and bacon pie' for 'Nut-eater plate' with almond milk and cashew cheese.
Swap 'Pressed carrot and apple juice' for 'Mr Tod's plant-based green juice'.
